LanguageData.VaultAllowDepositDesc: When enabled, haulers may store items in this building (enabled by default).
LanguageData.VaultAllowWithdrawDesc: When enabled, haulers may automatically take items, and workbench ingredients and eating/treatment search see this building's contents (enabled by default).
LanguageData.VaultAllowTakeForUse: Allow taking for use while withdrawing is disallowed
LanguageData.VaultAllowTakeForUseDesc: When "Allow withdrawing" is off, enabling this keeps workbench ingredients and eating/treatment search visible (hauling remains disabled).
LanguageData.VaultFrozenDesc: When enabled, hides all items in this building and pauses its work (the storage filter is left unchanged, and items remain in the outerrealm storage). Disable to show them again.
LanguageData.VaultAllowPortalTransferDesc: When enabled, this vault's stock may be picked up by hauling jobs heading into a cross-map portal (vehicle exit, gateway, etc.). Disabled by default: such pickups are refused, so third-party automation that mistakes outerrealm projections for ground items cannot haul the stock out of this map through a portal.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_ShowEntryDetail: Show each ordinary item's terminal visibility and each unique item's current or default vault. Disabled by default for a cleaner list.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_ExposeAllToTrad: Expose all inventory to orbital trade without beacons

Allow orbital traders to access every sellable item in outerrealm storage without checking beacons, maps, vault filters, frozen state, or withdrawal restrictions. Ordinary map items still require a beacon.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_OpenDesc: View all contents of subspace (ignoring every terminal filter), and force-eject or transfer them to a chosen map.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_NotUnique: This entry is not a unique item.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_VaultUnavailabl: The target vault is currently unavailable.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_VaultRejectsIte: The target vault's filter does not accept this item
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_ItemReserved: The item is reserved; its default vault cannot be moved yet.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_BatchBindingMod: Show unique items only and batch-assign their default vault using the current search and category filters. Every displayed item is selected by default when entering this mode.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_BatchBindNoSele: No unique items are currently selected.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_BatchBindResult: Bound {0} item(s) to {1}; {2} item(s) were not bound because of storage filters or reservations.
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_CatShowTip: All items in this category and its subcategories are shown (green ✓). Click to hide all
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_CatHideTip: All items in this category and its subcategories are hidden (red ×). Click to show all
LanguageData.OuterrealmStorageManager_CatPartialTip: Some items in this category are shown and some hidden (yellow ~). Click to hide all
LanguageData.SubspaceAccessManagerOpenDesc: Manage which pawns have subspace access (draw/deposit remotely).
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_OpenManagerDesc: Open the subspace storage manager to eject items nearby.
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_AutoTakeDesc: Automatically take ingredients from the pawn's subspace storage while crafting. When off, crafting uses the normal ingredient flow instead; manual take is unaffected.
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_AutoStoreDesc: Automatically deposit finished products into outerrealm storage after crafting. When off, products are handled by the vanilla flow; manual deposit is unaffected.
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_AutoStoreFilteredDesc: When auto-storing, check every outerrealm vault access point on the current map: a product is deposited only if at least one vault accepts it (allowed by its storage filter and not frozen / not deposit-blocked). If any other stockpile or storage building with a higher storage priority also accepts the product, it follows the vanilla priority rules and is not deposited, so it can end up in a designated stockpile. Off = auto-store everything.
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_AutoStoreFilteredDisabled: Requires "Auto store" to be enabled first.
LanguageData.SubspaceAccess_ConfirmDepositPendingInst: {0} is assigned to an installation or replanting blueprint. Putting it into subspace storage will cancel that blueprint. Continue?
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeLabel: Outerrealm vault access point right-click menu refresh mode
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeDesc: Controls how often the right-click menu is regenerated while open. Regenerating is expensive when the vault holds many item types; this reduces stutter.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeLazyDesc: Menu content stays fixed while open; options are re-validated against the current game state when clicked. Best performance; ideal because vault menu content barely changes while open.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModePeriodic: Frame-based: regenerate every N rendered frames
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModePeriodicDesc: Fully regenerates the menu every N rendered frames (default 60). Lower values keep the menu more up to date but each regeneration costs time when many items are stored.
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeAdaptive: Time-based: regenerate every N real seconds
LanguageData.VaultMenuRefreshModeAdaptiveDesc: Fully regenerates the menu every N real seconds (at least 4 frames apart), independent of framerate.
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_VaultExcludeFromWealth: Items in outerrealm vault access points do not count toward colony wealth
LanguageData.OmniCrafter_VaultExcludeFromWealthDesc: When enabled, items inside the vault do not count toward colony wealth (WealthItems) and do not contribute to raid points. Items already taken out or being hauled still count normally. Enabled by default.
LanguageData.VaultRightClickMenuModeDesc: Switches how the right-click menu looks when clicking THIS vault. Each vault is set independently and saved with the save file, so you can use the vanilla menu on some vaults and the custom menu on others. Vanilla: RimWorld's original menu. Custom: a big searchable list (supports pinyin) that pauses the game while open.
LanguageData.VaultCustomMenuModeDesc: Chooses the style used by this vault while its right-click menu is set to Custom Mode. Full list Mode preserves the previous behavior and generates every action at once. Two Step Mode opens the item list immediately and generates actions only after an item is selected, greatly reducing delays with large inventories.
LanguageData.VaultCustomMenuModeDisabledReason: Enable the custom list right-click menu first.
LanguageData.OuterrealmItemMenu_NoActions: The selected pawn has no available actions for this target.
LanguageData.VaultProjectionDiagnosticsDesc: Opens a read-only diagnostics window: shows which items this building currently projects and in what quantities, and highlights rows that need attention or look wrong (pending materialization, filtered out, projected stack size off, leftover empty entries, borrowed real items).
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_Permissions: Permissions: allow deposit {0}; allow withdraw {1}; allow take for use while withdrawing disallowed {2}; frozen {3}
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_Stats: Projected in view: {0}, borrowed: {1}; entries allowed by the filter: {2} (of which pending materialization: {3}); problems: {4}
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_Versions: Content version {0}, reservation version {1}, materialization queue: {2}
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_OnlyNoteworthy: Show only rows that need attention
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_Empty: This building currently projects no items.
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_TipCopyExpected: Expected projected stack: {0} (min(global total, stack limit {1}))
LanguageData.VaultProjDiag_TipOrphanCopy: No global entry matches this projection (ThingID {0}); it is an orphan copy and is normally cleaned up on the next view sync.
